world.name: Sky Aluminum

decision.declined: Retrospective roll (numbered wayfinding conflicts with the no-kicker craft floor)

dosageRules: backdrop-filter (saturate(180%) blur(20px)) is spent ONLY on the header capsule; content sheets are translucent-without-blur at .88-.9 alpha (sub-second first paint + GPU budget)
Glass is chrome, sheets are solid: pills and chips sitting ON a sheet use --pill-line/--pill-bg (ghost treatment), never --glass-* tokens or blur
Gold (--gold/--gold-wash) is spent on exactly one subject: the award metric (hero award fact, metric-chips, award tiles, return badge)
Alarm (--alarm) is spent only on the diagram's blocker node
One blue accent owns action, links, focus, and the timeline spine; stage hues (--stage-accent/--stage-lead) live only inside the hero diagram stage
The still-ground rule: nothing behind the content is animated or tinted - one flat neutral ground on html (graphite revision, 2026-09-13, replaced the aurora field)
Dark tokens are written twice in app.css: the prefers-color-scheme block guarded by :not([data-theme="light"]) AND :root[data-theme="dark"] - change both
One shared ease-out clock cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) for reveals and hover lifts; reveals animate translate/scale, never transform (reserved for hover lifts)
bannedPatterns: Numbered section wayfinding (declined at direction time)
Stat-card bands (facts are one woven mono line)
Unconditional opacity: 0 or any hiding rule not gated behind .js-motion from motion.js
IntersectionObserver thresholds > 0 (blanks tall sections on phones)
Visual design on the printed CV - it stays ATS-plain by product rule
Contact dock or reading-progress bar reaching paper (both hidden in @media print)
Animated or tinted backdrop layers behind the content (the aurora field was removed 2026-09-13 for reading as generated decor)
Coloured hover glows - hover response is the neutral --shadow-lift
The phone number printed as visible text on the showcase - it travels in the contact dock's tel: href only

paper.provenance: exact --finish-iphone18pro glacier token from apple.com/iphone-18-pro CSS, cross-checked against Apple swatch PNG

accent-bright.displayName: Accent Bright - Apple blue (focus ring, spine)

display.purpose: Hero headline only; each line in its own clipping box for the one-time unmask.

body.purpose: All prose, capped at the 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Geist Mono uppercase labels, data, and the hero facts line; carries all numerals with tabular-nums.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet
shadows.purpose: Every content sheet: contact step, mid lift, wide blue-cast atmosphere.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Header capsule, the diagram stage, and the contact dock.

shadows.name: glass-highlight
shadows.purpose: Inner top edge that says real glass; glass chrome only.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: The neutral hover response under buttons, chips, and study links; never coloured, never at rest.

motion.name: ease-clock
motion.purpose: The shared ease-out clock: reveals (.7s), stagger (.55s, 50ms/item), button and chip translate (.2-.22s).

motion.name: reveal-property-rule
motion.purpose: transform is reserved for hover lifts so the individual properties compose with it.

motion.name: hero-guard
motion.value: sessionStorage heroPlayed=1; scrollY > 40; performance.now() > 1500ms boot deadline - any one skips and the hero is never armed
motion.purpose: Motion never replays over a reader; a skipped visitor gets the static hero, never armed-but-invisible.

motion.name: progress-bar
motion.purpose: Reading progress with no script and no markup; @supports guarded; hidden in print.

motion.name: still-ground
motion.value: nothing behind the content animates or is tinted
motion.purpose: The graphite revision's central decision: all movement lives inside the content, all depth on the slabs.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Header capsule wraps to two rows (radius 24px); scroll-margin-top 92px -> 112px.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Hero grid stacks; diagram body to one column, bridge rotates horizontal.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Timeline gains the 10.5rem right-aligned period column.

material.edge-technique: 1px transparent border + solid face in padding-box over the gradient in border-box; gradient borders keep their radius this way
material.stage: linear-gradient(180deg, #101a26, #0a0f16) plus one quiet sky wash; dark blue-charcoal in both themes; --stage-legacy silver-steel marks the legacy estate, --stage-lead sky marks what replaced it

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Blue capsule action; hover lifts 1px and takes the neutral shadow lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.45rem; min-height:44px; padding:.6rem 1.35rem; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent; font:inherit; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; background:var(--action-bg,#0066cc); color:var(--action-ink,#ffffff); transition: translate .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .22s ease, background-color .22s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--action-bg-hover,#0059b3); translate:0 -1px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift,0 10px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.14)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { translate:0 0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright,#0071e3); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px; }

components.name: Ghost Pill Button
components.description: On-sheet ghost capsule: pill tokens, no blur; hover takes the accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.45rem; min-height:44px; padding:.6rem 1.35rem; border-radius:999px; font:inherit; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--pill-line,rgba(0,0,0,.24)); background:var(--pill-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.7)); color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); transition: translate .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .22s ease, color .22s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:var(--accent,#0066cc); color:var(--accent,#0066cc); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright,#0071e3); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:4px; }

components.name: Glass Header Capsule
components.description: The one true glass: floating capsule with backdrop-filter, deepening when content scrolls beneath (add the is-scrolled class).
components.html:
Bahaa Aldeen Mohamed
SkillsExperienceWorkCV
components.css: .ds-capsule { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; gap:.75rem; min-height:56px; padding:.35rem .4rem .35rem 1.1rem; border-radius:999px; background:var(--glass-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.58)); border:1px solid var(--glass-line,rgba(255,255,255,.65)); box-shadow:var(--shadow-float,0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.08),0 12px 28px rgba(16,24,40,.12)), var(--glass-highlight,inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45)); backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur,saturate(180%) blur(20px)); -webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur,saturate(180%) blur(20px)); transition: background-color .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease; } .ds-capsule.is-scrolled { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--glass-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.58)) 72%, var(--paper,#f5f5f7)); } .ds-capsule__name { font-weight:600; font-size:.98rem; letter-spacing:-.01em; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-capsule__nav { display:flex; gap:.15rem; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-inline-start:auto; } .ds-capsule__nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 .85rem; border-radius:999px; color:var(--ink-soft,#424245); text-decoration:none; font-size:.92rem; transition: color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-capsule__nav a:hover { color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink,#1d1d1f) 7%, transparent); }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: iOS-style theme switch: 46x26 track in a 44px hit area, polished-aluminum knob (transform-based travel for old-WebView support) carrying the sun/moon glyph in pure CSS state. Tap toggles; drag past midpoint switches via el.click() so Blazor aria stays in sync; a WAAPI ripple (.theme-pulse) previews the other theme's ground inside-out with the drag, pulses out on commit, retreats on spring-back; View Transitions cross-dissolve where supported. Reduced motion: instant swap, no pulse.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:44px; min-height:44px; padding:0; background:transparent; border:none; cursor:pointer; touch-action:none; } .ds-theme-toggle__track { position:relative; display:block; width:46px; height:26px; border-radius:999px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink,#16222e) 12%, transparent); border:1px solid var(--line,rgba(22,34,46,.12)); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(10,18,28,.16); transition:background-color .25s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover .ds-theme-toggle__track { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink,#16222e) 20%, transparent); } .ds-theme-toggle__knob { position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; display:grid; place-items:center; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(145deg, #ffffff, #d9e3ec); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65); box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(15,28,42,.35); color:var(--ink-soft,#44586b); translate:0 0; transition:translate .18s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1), background .25s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle.is-dragging .ds-theme-toggle__knob { transition:none; } .ds-theme-toggle__knob svg { width:12px; height:12px; } .ds-theme-toggle .ds-icon-sun { display:block; } .ds-theme-toggle .ds-icon-moon { display:none; } .ds-theme-toggle.ds-dark .ds-theme-toggle__knob { translate:22px 0; background:linear-gradient(145deg, #c7d5e2, #8fa3b5); } .ds-theme-toggle.ds-dark .ds-icon-sun { display:none; } .ds-theme-toggle.ds-dark .ds-icon-moon { display:block; }

components.name: Skill Chip
components.description: Scannable skill pill; the employer backing it sits in mono. Hover lifts and takes the accent border.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.4rem; max-width:100%; min-height:32px; padding:.3rem .85rem; border:1px solid var(--sheet-line,rgba(0,0,0,.08)); border-radius:999px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--sheet-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.9)) 80%, transparent); color:var(--ink-soft,#424245); font-size:.88rem; transition: translate .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { translate:0 -1px; border-color:var(--accent,#0066cc); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift,0 10px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.14)); color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); } .ds-chip__where { font-family:var(--font-mono,"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:400; color:var(--ink-faint,#56575b); }

components.name: Evidenced Chip
components.description: An evidenced skill outranks an unevidenced one: ink weight, accent wash, accent-mixed border.
components.css: .ds-chip-evidenced { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.4rem; min-height:32px; padding:.3rem .85rem; border-radius:999px; font-size:.88rem; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); font-weight:600; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent,#0066cc) 38%, var(--sheet-line,rgba(0,0,0,.08))); background:var(--accent-wash,#e8f1fb); } .ds-chip-evidenced__where { font-family:var(--font-mono,"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:400; color:var(--ink-faint,#56575b); }

components.description: The page's only gold: the squared 8px chip marking an award-earning metric.
components.css: .ds-metric-chip { display:inline-block; padding:.12rem .55rem; border-radius:8px; background:var(--gold-wash,#fbf3e2); color:var(--gold,#8a6116); font-weight:700; font-size:.85rem; }

components.name: Content Sheet
components.description: The content slab: translucent without blur, 16px radius, three-stage shadow. All dense text lives on one of these.

Sheet title

Dense content floats as one rounded slab over the aurora field.
components.css: .ds-sheet { padding:clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 3vw, 3.75rem) clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 3.25rem); background:var(--sheet-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.9)); border:1px solid var(--sheet-line,rgba(0,0,0,.08)); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sheet,0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.05),0 12px 32px rgba(16,24,40,.08),0 32px 80px rgba(10,80,160,.07)); } .ds-sheet__title { margin:0 0 .6rem; font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(1.85rem,1.15rem + 2.6vw,2.9rem); letter-spacing:-.028em; line-height:1.18; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); } .ds-sheet__lede { margin:0; max-width:68ch; font-size:1.05rem; line-height:1.6; color:var(--ink-soft,#424245); }

components.name: Testimonial Tile

components.css: .ds-testimonial { margin:0; padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 1.25rem; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--sheet-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.9)) 70%, var(--paper,#f5f5f7)); border:1px solid var(--sheet-line,rgba(0,0,0,.08)); border-radius:12px; } .ds-testimonial__quote { margin:0 0 1.1rem; } .ds-testimonial__quote p { margin:0; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); line-height:1.65; font-size:.98rem; } .ds-testimonial__quote p::before { content:"\201C"; display:block; font-family:var(--font-display,"Geist",sans-serif); font-size:2rem; line-height:.6; color:var(--accent,#0066cc); margin:.4rem 0 .7rem; } .ds-testimonial__by { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; } .ds-testimonial__avatar { flex:none; display:grid; place-items:center; width:2.6rem; height:2.6rem; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent-wash,#e8f1fb); color:var(--accent,#0066cc); font-weight:600; font-size:.9rem; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-testimonial__who { display:grid; gap:.1rem; } .ds-testimonial__name { font-weight:600; color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f); } .ds-testimonial__meta { color:var(--ink-faint,#56575b); font-size:.86rem; }

components.css: .ds-stage { padding:1.4rem 1.5rem 1.6rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-accent,#0a84ff) 26%, rgba(255,255,255,.1)); border-radius:14px; background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 80% -10%, rgba(90,200,216,.10), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, #131a26, #0d1016); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07), var(--shadow-float,0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.08),0 12px 28px rgba(16,24,40,.12)); } .ds-stage__label { margin:0 0 1.1rem; font-family:var(--font-mono,"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace); font-size:.78rem; color:rgba(226,234,244,.6); } .ds-stage__body { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 2.25rem 1fr; gap:.85rem; align-items:stretch; } .ds-stage__panel { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.4rem; padding:.9rem .8rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.045); } .ds-stage__panel--before { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm,#b0432c) 42%, rgba(255,255,255,.12)); } .ds-stage__panel--after { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-lead,#5ac8d8) 46%, rgba(255,255,255,.12)); } .ds-node { padding:.42rem .55rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius:6px; font-size:.72rem; color:rgba(226,234,244,.82); text-align:center; } .ds-node--blocker { border-style:dashed; border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm,#b0432c) 65%, rgba(255,255,255,.12)); color:#f4a08d; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--alarm,#b0432c) 16%, transparent); } .ds-node--lead { border-color:var(--stage-lead,#5ac8d8); color:var(--stage-lead,#5ac8d8); font-weight:600; } .ds-bridge { width:2px; justify-self:center; align-self:stretch; background:linear-gradient(180deg, var(--stage-accent,#0a84ff), var(--stage-lead,#5ac8d8)); border-radius:999px; }

components.name: Contact Dock
components.description: One frosted capsule fixed to the viewport's foot: Call and Email as plain anchors (tel:/mailto:), no script, present in the prerendered shell and the Blazor render. True glass (dock-bg + blur) with a single-tone silver rim; the page's second and last blur; hidden in print.
components.html: CallEmail
components.css: .ds-dock { position:fixed; bottom:calc(.9rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); right:.9rem; z-index:40; display:flex; gap:.3rem; margin:0; padding:.3rem; background:var(--dock-bg,rgba(255,255,255,.6)); border:1px solid var(--edge-silver,#b3c1ce); border-radius:999px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-float,0 2px 6px rgba(30,45,65,.08),0 12px 28px rgba(30,45,65,.12)), var(--glass-highlight,inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5)); backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur,saturate(180%) blur(20px)); -webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur,saturate(180%) blur(20px)); } @media (max-width:720px){ .ds-dock { left:.9rem; right:.9rem; justify-content:center; } } .ds-dock__action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.4rem; min-height:44px; padding:0 1rem; border-radius:999px; color:var(--ink-soft,#424245); text-decoration:none; font-size:.92rem; font-weight:600; transition:color .2s ease, background-color .2s ease; } .ds-dock__action svg { width:17px; height:17px; } .ds-dock__action:hover { color:var(--accent,#0066cc); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink,#1d1d1f) 7%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: The site behaves like a native Apple app: frosted glass chrome and anodized-silver metal edges over solid content sheets on one still Sky Aluminum ground (silvery blue-paper light, blue-slate night, Apple's action blue - the user's own proposal after three re-tints, 2026-09-13). The dosage law: glass is chrome - exactly two fixed blurs, capsule and dock; sheets are solid. First paint stays under a second - a product rule, not a preference. Motion is one orchestrated system on a shared ease-out clock: sections settle in as sheets, items stagger at 50ms per index, and the hero plays a single sequence - only for qualifying visits. Hiding is additive-only, gated behind .js-motion added by motion.js and nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: Still ground: one flat surface on html (silvery blue-paper light, blue-slate night) - nothing layered, nothing animated behind the content.
Anodized-silver gradient edges frame every sheet; the header capsule and contact dock are the only true glass (two fixed matchbox blurs); gold metal is awards-only.
One blue accent for action, links, and focus; gold spent on exactly one subject (awards); alarm red only for the diagram's blocker; stage hues only inside the stage.
Geist + Geist Mono; negative tracking on every heading; mono carries all data and labels.
Capsule radii (999px) for all interactive chrome; hairlines, not boxes, separate content inside a sheet.
Reduced motion restores every hidden state; the printed CV sits outside this system entirely (ATS-plain by product rule).

rules.name: The Gold Is Singular Rule
rules.body: Gold is spent on exactly one subject — the award metric — and nowhere else. Its rarity is what makes the award land.

rules.name: The Twice-Written Rule
rules.body: Dark tokens are written twice in app.css — the guarded prefers-color-scheme block and the [data-theme="dark"] rule. Any token change is made in both places, always.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading — no kickers, no eyebrows, no numbered wayfinding. A section opens with its heading; attribution goes below it, in mono, in Ink Faint.

rules.name: The Two-Row Capsule Rule
rules.body: At 720px the capsule wraps to two rows inside one capsule (~98px tall, compacted 2026-09-13 from ~118px); the mobile scroll-margin-top is 112px because of it. If the capsule is ever compacted or expanded, that 112px must move with it — the two are one decision.

rules.name: The Chrome-Only Blur Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter (saturate(180%) blur(20px)) is spent exclusively on the header capsule. Content sheets are translucent without blur — render cost for nothing behind a .9-alpha sheet.

rules.name: The Scrolled-Depth Rule
rules.body: The capsule's glass deepens once content passes underneath (.is-scrolled at scrollY > 8) — state, not motion, so it runs regardless of reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Still-Ground Rule
rules.body: Nothing behind the content animates or carries tint — one flat neutral ground on html. All movement lives inside the content; all depth lives on the slabs.

dos: Do write any dark token change in both places — the guarded prefers-color-scheme block and the [data-theme="dark"] rule (The Twice-Written Rule).
Do gate every hiding rule behind .js-motion from motion.js, and restore every hidden state in the reduced-motion blocks.
Do keep backdrop-filter on chrome only; sheets stay translucent-without-blur at .88–.9 alpha.
Do keep gold on awards only, and the alarm on the diagram's blocker only.
Do keep 44px tap targets, the 68ch measure, and the 112px mobile scroll-margin in step with the two-row capsule.
Do keep the prerendered <div class="prerendered"> a direct child of #app, and mirror any header or contact-dock change in prerender.py (static_shell_header / static_contact_dock) byte-for-byte.
Do carry final values in markup for anything a script counts or reveals — the static layer is the contract.
Do verify both themes at 390×844 and desktop width before calling anything done.
donts: Don't put kickers or eyebrows above headings, and don't add border-left accent stripes — both are below the craft floor (The No-Kicker Rule).
Don't build a stat-card band; the facts are one mono line woven into the hero.

Don't blur content, and don't put anything animated or tinted behind the content - the ground is one flat, still surface (the still-ground rule; the aurora field was removed 2026-09-13 for reading as generated decor).
Don't give the hero sequence to a visitor who scrolled, has seen it this session, or waited past the 1500ms boot deadline — and never arm without a proved restore path.
Don't raise the reveal IntersectionObserver threshold above 0 — a height-ratio threshold blanks tall sections on phones.

Don't print the design: the contact dock and progress bar are hidden in print, below-fold reveals are force-restored, and the printed CV (/cv document, print.css, EmptyLayout) stays deliberately ATS-plain outside this system by product rule.
Don't adopt numbered section wayfinding — the "Retrospective" discipline was declined at direction time; section numbers conflict with the No-Kicker Rule.
Don't print the phone number as visible text on the showcase - it travels in the contact dock's tel: href only (anti-scrape posture, 2026-09-13).
